card.line: The Valley of Jezreel is a wide, fertile plain in Israel where enemy armies camped against Gideon and where Ahab, Jehu, and Jezebel's story played out nearby.

moments.title: Enemy armies camp here
moments.text: The Midianites, Amalekites, and other eastern peoples crossed the Jordan and camped in the Valley of Jezreel. The Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he rallied Israel to meet them.
